sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A rhizomatous, dioecious perennial herbaceous vine that climbs by twining and can reach 6–7 m. It grows in hedges, woodland margins and moist soils of temperate Eurasia.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: Female plants bear hanging cones 2–3 cm long, harvested for brewing. They contain small achenes.

sections.title: Uses and toxicity
sections.text: The female inflorescences are used to flavour and bitter beer. Hops can cause severe poisoning in dogs; do not give them to dogs.
